images.brief: Main board is exactly FIVE columns by FIVE data rows, 25 square drawer lids with headers id, name, score, dept, city OUTSIDE the grid. Data rows: (1,MIN,90,DEV,SEOUL); (2,JUN,55,ART,BUSAN); (3,SEO,80,DEV,SEOUL); (4,DO,NULL,ART,SEOUL); (5,HA,70,PLAN,DAE). Header name and score selected cyan. Full rows 1 and 3 have soft amber condition tint; just their name/score intersection cells are mint green. Other cells keep neutral or faint cyan column tint. One small robot stands at row3 score cell, value80 remains readable in a small hover tag. A short two-step dotted footprint shows movement, not arrows to correct answers. Toolbar: blue column brush, gold condition brush, eraser. Right dark code panel EXACT text in large readable monospaced letters: SELECT name, score\nFROM students\nWHERE score >= 80; Beneath, a tiny result table with MIN 90 and SEO 80. Top small quest: Find students scoring 80+. A tiny cursor glow links the brush action to WHERE line.
images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup / stylized game concept. Create ONE coherent 16:9 landscape playable screen design for NODEVERSE's revised SQL DRAWER COLORING game. Match reference material palette only: warm beveled wood, cream stone, blue trim, tiny turquoise sea edge. Main interface is a small horizontal walkable 5x5 data-drawer BOARD seen from nearly TOP-DOWN with minimal perspective and clearly readable square lids, NOT a vertical tall cabinet, NOT a spreadsheet covering the entire screen. Grid takes left ~65% of screen; LIVE SQL code and compact result tray take right ~30%. Each row is a record, column a field; headers outside exact5x5 data count. One compact SD WHITE ROBOT with black faceplate, TWO green eyes, green chest light, small feet, stands ON the drawer board and hops from cell to cell. No second robot, no humans, no couriers, no code sentence choice buttons. Compact tools support painting and extraction. Color overlays are translucent with cell borders visible. Clear uncluttered high quality toy-like 3D-to-2D game UI, readable data and accurate short code. Text inside cells and code in English as specified, do not add tiny fake labels, watermarks or explanatory paragraphs. images.title: 5×5 집계 · 같은 행끼리 색 묶기
images.brief: Main board is exactly FIVE columns and FIVE data rows, 25 square drawer lids, separate headers id,name,score,dept,city. Data rows: (1,MIN,90,DEV,SEOUL); (2,JUN,55,ART,BUSAN); (3,SEO,80,DEV,SEOUL); (4,DO,NULL,ART,SEOUL); (5,HA,70,PLAN,DAE). Whole rows 1 and3 share soft blue group paint; rows2 and4 soft gold paint; row5 lavender. Thin grid lines and values remain legible. Header dept has a group-brush outline. A SINGLE small robot stands on dept column row2, applying a tiny paint stamp; no walking courier or carried records. Below main board three compact group drawers DEV:2, ART:2, PLAN:1, connected by subtle color ribbons to grouped rows. Toolkit only group brush, count icon, sum icon, eraser. Right dark code panel EXACT: SELECT dept, COUNT(*)\nFROM students\nGROUP BY dept; Result table DEV 2, ART 2, PLAN 1. Include a subtle NULL mark on score for DO so a later count distinction can be taught.

images.title: 5×5 JOIN · 같은 키 색 연결
images.brief:
Main play area shows TWO small 5-column by 5-data-row square drawer boards side by side, each25 cells, with separate header labels. Left columns id,name,dept_id,score,city. Left five rows: (1,MIN,10,90,SEOUL);(2,JUN,20,55,BUSAN);(3,SEO,10,80,SEOUL);(4,DO,99,NULL,SEOUL);(5,HA,NULL,70,DAE). Right columns id,name,city,floor,active. Right rows (10,DEV,SEOUL,1,1);(20,ART,BUSAN,2,1);(30,PLAN,DAE,3,1);(40,OPS,SEOUL,4,1);(50,LAB,BUSAN,5,1). Cyan key brush outlines left dept_id and right id. Three fine distinct connections: left10 row1->right10 row1, left20 row2->right20 row2, left10 row3->right10 row1. Unmatched left rows4,5 have neutral striped marks, not removed. One small white robot stands on LEFT board at a key cell with a tiny paint dab. Right dark code panel EXACT: SELECT s.name, d.name
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN depts d
ON s.dept_id = d.id; Result MIN DEV; JUN ART; SEO DEV; DO NULL; HA NULL. No large pipes, no carrying cards, no extra character.

images.title: 5×5 서브쿼리 · 계산값으로 다시 색칠
images.brief:
One main board exactly FIVE columns by FIVE data rows, 25 square drawer lids, headers id,name,score,dept,city separate. Same rows (1,MIN,90,DEV,SEOUL);(2,JUN,55,ART,BUSAN);(3,SEO,80,DEV,SEOUL);(4,DO,NULL,ART,SEOUL);(5,HA,70,PLAN,DAE). Score column softly outlined gold for inner calculation. Below board a small FIVE-cell score strip 90,55,80,NULL,70 leads to average bubble73.75; NULL is neutral gray and omitted from calculation. A short arrow from73.75 to a greater-than comparison brush above board; full rows1 and3 get soft mint tint, selected name/score output cells brighter mint. One SMALL robot on score column row3 with tiny brush spark. Right dark code panel EXACT multiline monospaced: SELECT name, score
FROM students
WHERE score > (
  SELECT AVG(score)
  FROM students
); Output MIN90 and SEO80. Inner SELECT lines softly gold-highlighted and outer WHERE cyan-highlighted. No second large grid, no card transportation.
